_source: plone.restapi, every name="@..." registered in its configure.zcml files. Regenerated from the source rather than transcribed: the hand-made list carried @inherit, which plone.restapi has never registered, and missed @refresh-lock, @tiles and @unlock.
_regenerate: From a local checkout: grep -rhoE 'name="@[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+"' <plone.restapi>/src --include='*.zcml' | sed 's/name="//;s/"//' | sort -u. Without one: gh api repos/plone/plone.restapi/tarball/main | tar xz && the same grep over */src/plone/restapi.
_why: The mock is the only thing our Plone adapter is tested against, so a route this file does not list is a route no real Plone answers. An endpoint listed here WRONGLY is the worse direction: it waves an invention through as core. See mock-serves-no-invented-endpoints.test.js.
